title: Not as Described
text: Not as Described. Pretty sure these aren’t stainless. They look and sound like they are just coated. Time will tell but I’m predicting that they are going to rust in the middle. Okay looking plates for now but definitely not worth the price. They’ll work for camping but definitely not the elegant plates they advertise.
